 Order

This is the first application under Section 482 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, for grant of anticipatory bail filed by the applicants (Deepak Bundela and Dilip Raghuvanshi), who apprehend their arrest in connection with Crime No.305/2025 registered at Police Station Chanderi,
District Ashoknagar (M.P.) for the commission of offence under Section 420 of IPC.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:14068 2 MCRC-29921-2025 2.
Learned counsel for the applicants submit that the applicants have been falsely implicated in the matter.
they have not committed any offence in any manner.
They are ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this court.

Learned counsel for the applicants pray that the application may be allowed in terms of decision of the Apex Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar Vs.
State of Bihar, (2014) 8 SCC 273 .
3.

sentences.text: 4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, since the offence in question attracts punishment less than 7 years, therefore, in view of the principles laid down by the Supreme Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar (Supra), it is directed that police may resort to the extreme step of arrest only when the same is necessary and the applicants do not cooperate in the investigation.
The applicants should first be summoned to cooperate in the investigation.
If the applicants cooperate in the investigation, then the occasion of their arrest should not arise.
5. With the aforesaid directions, the present anticipatory bail application stands disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.

(ASHISH SHROTI) JUDGE JPS/-
